_comment: Trust store for the step 6 fixture (plan step 6, ee.riik.poa.1 over a wallet-generated device key). One mock issuer key, accepted for BOTH doctypes: the national ee.riik.poa.1 and the EU AV Profile eu.europa.ec.av.1 (EE-POA-003 issues both from the same source in one transaction). This is the file a real deployment would load with oid4vp.LoadTrustStore; the zk package re-reads it in its tests because the zk package cannot import oid4vp (oid4vp imports zk).
